a: Design for small screens first, then enhance for larger breakpoints.
Touch targets should be large enough (about 44×44 pt/dp minimum guidance).
Offline-first apps cache data and sync when connectivity returns.
Request permissions in context and explain why they are needed.
Universal/App Links open specific app screens from web URLs.
Ask for notification permission after demonstrating value, not on first launch only.
Use crash reporters (e.g. Sentry/Firebase Crashlytics) to fix stability issues.
Use semantic-ish version codes/names required by Play Store and App Store.
TestFlight distributes iOS betas to testers before App Store release.
Play Console internal/closed testing tracks release Android builds to testers.
Reduce APK/IPA size with splits, compression, and removing unused resources.
Biometrics (fingerprint/face) improve UX but need secure fallback PINs.
